title: Tactile Tree Mapping
instruction: Find three different trees nearby. Close your eyes and touch their bark with both hands. Compare the furrow depth, temperature, and roughness.
screen_rule: Slide your phone deep into your pocket or pack.
equipment_needed: None — your hands and sense of touch
follow_up_prompt: Which tree felt warmest to the touch?

title: Acoustic Triangulation
instruction: Stand completely still. Close your eyes and listen for birdsong. Point with your index finger in the direction of the first call you hear, then rotate if a second bird responds.
screen_rule: Lock your screen and keep your hands free.
follow_up_prompt: Did you hear two distinct species communicating?

title: Leaf Vein Geometry
instruction: Find a fallen leaf. Hold it up toward the sky so the sunlight shines through it. Trace the primary midrib vein and count how many secondary veins branch outward.
screen_rule: Keep your screen dark and locked.
equipment_needed: One fallen leaf and natural sunlight
follow_up_prompt: Were the branching angles symmetrical or staggered?

title: The Forager's Trail
instruction: Find an ant, beetle, or flying insect on a plant or path. Without touching or blocking it, track its journey for 3 continuous minutes. Watch how it navigates obstacles.
follow_up_prompt: What barrier did the insect encounter, and how did it adapt?

title: Sky & Wind Drift
instruction: Look up at the highest cloud or treetops. Align a fixed reference point (like a lamp post or branch tip) with the cloud edge and measure how long it takes to move out of alignment.
screen_rule: Place your device face down on a bench or in your bag.
equipment_needed: An open view of the sky
follow_up_prompt: Was the upper wind blowing in the same direction as the surface breeze?

title: Petrichor & Forest Floor
instruction: Crouch down near damp soil, leaf litter, or moss. Take three slow, deep diaphragmatic breaths through your nose. Notice the earthy aroma produced by geosmin and actinobacteria.
follow_up_prompt: Did the air smell sweet, mineral, or woody?

title: 1-Meter Micro Safari
instruction: Pick an arbitrary 1-meter square of lawn, flowerbed, or path edge. Count how many distinct shades of green exist within that single square meter.
follow_up_prompt: How many green shades did you differentiate?

title: Solar Angle & Shadow Length
instruction: Stand tall in a sunny patch. Estimate your shadow length relative to your height. Notice which compass direction your shadow points away from the sun.
follow_up_prompt: Is your shadow longer or shorter than your body?
